messages.subject: Data for distance sampling analyses
parts:
Hello everyone,
I have point count data for several locations (that vary in elevation, latitude etc). I want to evaluate if variables such as elevation or type of habitat affect the abundance of my study species. In each point I registered the individuals of the species and the distance of detection(in some points I have no individuals, in others one, and in few I have more than one). For each point I also registered information about habitat (local canopy height, understory density etc).

Overall, I am not very sure how to organize my data frame. What is "transect" in my case? I know this is a really broad and basic question, but I new to this R package and this analyses. I would really appreaciate your hel in this matter.

Thank you all for your time,

Laura
